Federal funding helps keep water clean, safe, and affordable in Wisconsin, but with persistent threats like lead pipes, aging water infrastructure, and harmful contaminants, more support is needed. Learn more in this piece with our partners Milwaukee Water Commonsl:

All of the Great Lakes states have high need for funding for water infrastructure, including Pennsylvania at $37 billion. Learn more about water infrastructure issues in PA at HealthyLakes.org/in-your-state

New York needs over $89 billion to upgrade its water infrastructure(!) and it can only do so with continued federal funding for drinking water and wastewater infrastructure improvements. Learn more at HealthyLakes.org/in-your-state

Minnesota needs over $16 billion to upgrade outdated and crumbling wastewater and drinking water infrastructure. Now is the time for more federal investments, not less! Learn more at HealthyLakes.org/in-your-state

Indiana needs a staggering $21.916 billion for water infrastructure upgrades. The Great Lakes region is struggling with outdated and failing water infrastructure and we need funding to change that. Learn more at HealthyLakes.org/in-your-state

Illinois needs $33.586 billion over the next 20 years for water infrastructure investments. After decades of underinvestment, we need to put forward funding to meet these challenges. Learn more at HealthyLakes.org/in-your-state
Yesterday was World Wetlands Day! Wetlands are a core part of the water system, but a Supreme Court decision in 2023 put them at risk. Learn more in this video.
